decisions.reason: Semi-hard cheese builds directly on the firm's existing cheese-making knowledge, so absorptive capacity supports learning and improvement, making a drop unlikely.
As a product line with several models, spicy cheese leverages the firm's dairy expertise and shows commitment, suggesting strong absorptive capacity and a low drop probability.
Mild creamy soft cheese fits the firm's cultured dairy and cheese capabilities, enabling assimilation of market feedback and continuous improvement, so keep.
